title: IVG Intense Salts Forest Berries Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Forest Berries Ice blends together a rich mix of woodland fruits, combining notes of Blackcurrant, Cherry, and Red Berries for a layered taste that’s both sweet and tangy. The fruit is lifted by a brisk streak of Ice, adding a cooling edge that sharpens the profile without overwhelming it. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid provides consistent flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it’s ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits, vape pens, and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Forest Berries Ice offers a balanced combination of bold fruit and refreshing chill, designed to satisfy fans of fruity blends with an icy twist.
